sum: Brightline Interactive, Inc., a software technology company focused on Physical AI infrastructure through SpatialCore platform in the United States. The company develops SpatialCore is an open standards-based interoperability and operational context platform that connects autonomous systems, sensors, digital twins, AI models, and other data sources into a unified operational environment. It primarily serves defense, government, and commercial markets. The company was formerly known as The Glimpse Group, Inc. and changed its name to Brightline Interactive, Inc. in August 2026. Brightline Interactive, Inc. was incorporated in 2016 and is headquartered in Ashburn, Virginia.
